units.source_text: 正月二十三日是子日，髭黑左大将的夫人玉鬘先来祝寿，奉献新菜。

en.t: On the twenty-third day of the first month, the Day of the Rat, Tamakazura, wife of the Left Captain Higekuro, came first to offer birthday congratulations and present the new herbs.

units.source_text: 玉鬘的准备工作做得非常秘密，预先不漏一点风声。

en.t: Tamakazura had made her preparations in the strictest secrecy, without letting even the slightest hint leak out beforehand.

units.source_text: 突如其来，源氏无法阻止，只得生受了。

en.t: Because it came so suddenly, Genji had no way to stop it and could only accept it as it was.

units.source_text: 此时玉鬘威势十足，这一天出门虽说是微行，但仪仗之盛，异乎寻常。

en.t: By this time Tamakazura possessed great influence, and although her outing that day was said to be private, the splendor of her escort was extraordinary.

units.source_text: 源氏的御座设在朝南大殿西边的小客厅里。

en.t: Genji's seat was set up in a small reception room on the west side of the south-facing main hall.

units.source_text: 室中旧物尽行撤去，自屏风、幔帐以至一切陈设，全用新物。

en.t: All the old things in the room had been removed, and everything from the screens and curtains to every furnishing was newly provided.

units.source_text: 但不用庄严堂皇的椅子，而用四十条中国席重叠起来，作为御座。

en.t: Instead of using a solemn and imposing chair, they stacked forty Chinese mats together and made them his seat.

units.source_text: 茵褥、矮几以至一切贺寿用的器物，都是崭新的。

en.t: The cushions, low tables, and every vessel used for the birthday celebration were all brand new.

units.source_text: 一对嵌螺钿的柜子上放着四只衣箱，里面装着冬夏服装。

en.t: On a pair of mother-of-pearl inlaid cabinets stood four clothing chests, filled with garments for winter and summer.

units.source_text: 此外，香壶、药箱、石砚、洗发盆、梳具箱等，都潜心设计，尽善尽美。

en.t: In addition, the incense jars, medicine boxes, stone inkstones, hair-washing basins, comb cases, and other items were all carefully designed and finished to perfection.

units.source_text: 放插头花的台，用沉香木及紫檀木制成。

en.t: The stands for holding the hair ornaments were made of aloeswood and red sandalwood.

units.source_text: 插头花质料虽然同是金银，但配色十分讲究，雅致而又新颖。

en.t: Although the hair ornaments themselves were all made of gold and silver, their colors were exquisitely coordinated, elegant, and fresh.

units.source_text: 原来这位尚侍深解风趣，富有才气，故万事别出心裁，叫人看了眼界一新。

en.t: This Lady Chamberlain had always deeply understood refinement and was rich in talent, so in everything she devised something original that opened people's eyes anew.

units.source_text: 但外表又并不故意招摇夸张。

en.t: Yet outwardly she never made a deliberate show of it or let it become ostentatious.
